R29 / A1: exact two-channel accounting with the unparsed term, and which fit Tab. S11 (supp_e35) uses.

Identity (per point = model x set). Let c = coverage (share of items with a written relation), and on covered items
W = written-relation accuracy, aT / aF = P(CoT answer agrees with the relation | relation true / false),
x = W - Dir|c, A = (1 - aF)(1 - W) - (1 - aT) W. With two options, CoT|c = aT W + (1 - aF)(1 - W), hence
    y_c := CoT|c - Dir|c = x + A                                       (exact if every CoT answer is A or B)
    y   := CoT - Dir (all items) = c (x + A) + (1 - c) Delta_u,  Delta_u := CoT|u - Dir|u on uncovered items
(uncovered = no consensus relation, incl. empty text after truncation). Residuals reported per point:
    r0 = y - (x + A)                         (what Tab. S10 leaves out)  = (1 - c)(Delta_u - (x + A))
    r1 = y - [c (x + A) + (1 - c) Delta_u]   (should be 0; non-zero only through non-A/B CoT answers)
    g  = y_c - (x + A)                       (same non-binary leak, on covered items)
Points: Tab. S10 (supp_e45: uniform protocol, judge consensus; 21 open synthetic + 2 extra + 13 natural + 13 closed),
Tab. S31 (supp_two_channel: claim_parse v3, conclusion kept; x + A = y on parsed items), Tab. S11 (= the 13 natural
points of Tab. S10). Item-cluster bootstrap (2,000; clusters as in Exp-45) for Delta_u and r0.

Fit comparison for the 13 natural instruct points and the 13 closed points (same x, y as Tabs. S10/S11):
    (i)   Tab. S31 fit (Exp-32; v3 parser, conclusion KEPT, synthetic): y_hat = -1.40 + 0.871 x  <- used by Tab. S11
    (ii)  Tab. S10 fit (Exp-45; judges, conclusion REMOVED, synthetic): y_hat = -4.55 + 0.745 x
    (iii) Exp-35 secondary fit (v3 parser on the conclusion-REMOVED synthetic text): -3.09 + 0.753 x
    (iv)  y = x
MAE / bias / sign agreement; image bootstrap of the natural points (images resampled jointly across models within a
dataset, fit fixed) and the same with the 21 synthetic points also resampled (fit refit per draw).
-> outputs/bundle/r29_two_channel_identity.json, outputs/bundle/rigor_r29_two_channel_identity.txt
Usage: python r29_two_channel_identity.py
